title: Graphic Designer
description:
What You'll Do Create visually engaging designs for branding, digital platforms, marketing campaigns, and communication materials . Develop creative concepts and visual directions based on project briefs, client requirements, and brand objectives. Design brand identities, logos, brand collaterals, presentations, brochures, and other print and digital assets . Create digital creatives for websites, social media, advertising campaigns, and other marketing touchpoints. Translate ideas and concepts into clear, impactful, and visually consistent designs. Work with typography, colour, composition, grids, and visual hierarchy to create effective design solutions. Understand client requirements and collaborate with internal teams to develop relevant creative outputs. Present design concepts and creative directions to clients, founders, and internal teams. Incorporate feedback and manage design iterations while maintaining quality and consistency. Ensure brand consistency across different platforms, formats, and communication materials. Prepare final artwork and production-ready files for digital and print applications. Organise design files, assets, and deliverables for efficient collaboration and handover. Stay updated with emerging design trends, tools, and creative techniques. Take ownership of assigned projects and ensure timely delivery without compromising design quality. 
 What We're Looking For 1 to 3 years of experience in graphic design or a similar creative role. A strong portfolio demonstrating branding, visual design, creative thinking, and design execution . Strong command of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator . Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign and familiarity with Figma. Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, grids, and visual hierarchy . Ability to develop original concepts rather than relying solely on templates or existing references. Understanding of brand identity, brand guidelines, and visual consistency. Ability to translate creative briefs and business requirements into effective visual solutions. Strong attention to detail and a good sense of aesthetics. Ability to explain creative decisions and present design concepts confidently. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable receiving feedback, refining concepts, and managing multiple design iterations. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines. A proactive approach to problem-solving, experimentation, and continuous learning. 
 Good to Have Experience in brand identity development and branding projects . Familiarity with motion graphics, animation, or video editing. Experience creating presentations, pitch decks, brochures, and marketing collaterals. Understanding of digital marketing creatives and advertising formats. Familiarity with Figma, Canva, and AI-assisted design tools. Experience preparing artwork for print production and understanding print specifications. Experience working in a creative agency or design studio. Experience presenting concepts and communicating directly with clients. Basic understanding of UI design and digital brand applications. Ability to work across different visual styles, industries, and project requirements. 
 What You'll Get Opportunity to work on real client projects across branding, digital design, marketing, and creative communication. Directly work with the founders and gain exposure to creative direction, client interactions, and project decisions. Opportunity to take ownership of projects and see your designs move from initial concepts to final execution. Exposure to diverse industries, brands, and creative challenges. Opportunity to collaborate with UI/UX designers, marketers, and other creative professionals. Mentorship and guidance from experienced designers and the creative team. A collaborative, creative, and people-first work environment. Opportunity to experiment with new ideas, design approaches, and creative tools. Build a strong professional portfolio through meaningful, real-world projects. Opportunity for long-term growth within the team. 
 How to Apply Interested candidates can share their resume and portfolio with us. Email: px@demasters.in
 Contact: 9075130122
